title: Dose Of Destruction
style: Stylized 3D cartoon render matching the existing roster: clean shapes, bold readable silhouette, saturated colors, soft studio light.
notes: Fighter art lives in C:\Projects\AllTheCharacters\<Folder>. DoD's devtools tune its own side-view, pose and clip prompts (content/generation.json); these presets are for one-off art outside that pipeline. Stage art: say 'game environment art, an empty scene: nobody in it' or Qwen paints fighters (docs/comfyui.md).

fighter-concept.description: A new fighter, full body, front three-quarter view, on green for keying.
fighter-concept.prompt: {prompt}. Full-body character, standing in a fighting stance, facing three-quarters toward the camera. {style} Plain flat pure green background, no floor, no shadow, even studio lighting.

fighter-turnaround.description: Eight camera angles of a fighter from one image (reference sheet for poses and clips).

stage-backdrop.description: A stage backdrop: game environment art, nobody in it.
stage-backdrop.prompt: Game environment art for a 2D platform fighter stage, an empty scene: nobody in it. {prompt}. Wide side-on view, readable depth, {style}

stage-theme.prompt: {prompt}, energetic fighting game stage theme, loopable, instrumental
